pathways.name: Amyloid Cascade & Abeta Processing
pathways.description: Sequential processing of APP by beta-secretase (BACE1) and gamma-secretase (PSEN1/PSEN2) releasing hydrophobic Abeta peptides.

pathways.name: Tau Phosphorylation & Tangle Pathogenesis
pathways.description: Aberrant hyperphosphorylation of Tau (MAPT) by kinases leading to detachment from microtubules and neurofibrillary tangle formation.

pathways.name: Microglial Response & Neuroinflammation
pathways.description: TREM2- and CD33-dependent activation of microglia surrounding amyloid plaques controlling phagocytosis and inflammatory cytokine secretion.

pathways.name: Lipid Metabolism & Apolipoprotein Transport
pathways.description: APOE- and ABCA7-mediated transport of cholesterol and phospholipids modulating membrane fluidity and amyloid clearance.

pathways.name: Endocytic Trafficking & Synaptic Plasticity
pathways.description: Clathrin-mediated endocytosis regulated by PICALM, BIN1, and SORL1 governing APP recycling and synaptic receptor turnover.
